original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a polished premium semi-realistic 3D character wardrobe TURNAROUND on clean white seamless studio background, matching input1's rendering texture exactly. Output ONE high-resolution landscape sheet with THREE evenly-spaced full-body views: strict frontal eye-level, exact left-side profile facing left, straight back. Same adult man Rhys in all three views, same clothes, same scale and ground line, relaxed arms with normal five-finger hands. INPUT1 is BODY/IDENTITY TURNAROUND MASTER; INPUT2 is FACE IDENTITY MASTER; INPUT3 is CLOTHING DESIGN ONLY, never copy its model face. Preserve gray eyes, deep espresso-brown tousled hair and refined face. Preserve tall lean male fashion-model anatomy 8.5–9 anatomical heads, counting skull crown-to-chin without hair or cat ears; small head, full long waist, long thighs and lower legs; do not enlarge head or squat body. Exactly TWO black feline ears and ONE anatomically attached long dark furry tail PER VIEW, emerging at rear sacrum through a tailored clothing opening, falling naturally to lower calf with gentle tip curve, never wrapping limbs or duplicating. Full feet and ears inside frame with margins. Clear neutral soft studio lighting, consistent skin and fabric color between all views. Do not add words, letters, labels, logos or watermark. Anatomically natural human face and hands, same character style as input1, no anime/photographic style drift. Reference 3: oversized cream/oatmeal textured deep-V knit pullover with wide ribbed neckline, dropped shoulders and relaxed long sleeves; underlayer ivory long-sleeve cotton POLO-COLLAR shirt with three buttons visible in V; ivory loose straight wide-leg trousers with understated side pocket. Replace sneakers with DARK ESPRESSO BROWN SUEDE PENNY LOAFERS and fine cream socks. No necktie; subtle black choker under shirt collar. Hem of knit at high hip, do not shorten legs. Warm tactile elegant domestic and rooftop look.
